question: KQ1
summary: FrameTransport is four methods (send/onMessage/onClose/ready) with two implementations: WebSocketFrameTransport and RelayFrameTransport whose ready() resolves only on SAS approval.
pwaAdoption: Adopt the seam verbatim in Pi Remote: ship WebSocketFrameTransport first, keep ready() as the single connection gate, add an E2EE carrier later without touching RpcClient or UI.

question: KQ1
summary: onMessage hands string|Uint8Array: string goes to parseRpcMessage (junk dropped), Uint8Array to decodePtyData (0x01 tag + 2-byte sessionId length + sessionId + payload), fanned out on IPC.ptyData(sessionId).
pwaAdoption: Maps 1:1 onto browser PWA WebSocket with binaryType=arraybuffer; keep terminal output on tagged binary frames, all control traffic JSON.

question: KQ1
summary: On carrier close RpcClient fails every pending request FIRST (clear map before reject, coded E_DISCONNECTED client-synthesized error), then notifies overlay hooks; rationale: a never-settling promise blocks all downstream cleanup.
pwaAdoption: Critical for mobile PWA on flaky cellular: guarantee every await settles on drop with a distinguished disconnect code so UI shows reconnect instead of a hung spinner.

question: KQ1
summary: buildRelayApi reuses the same ws-bridge builders over RelayFrameTransport; per-member routing decision: core-bound namespaces over RpcClient, app-global stay local via ...local spread; pty.onData deliberately bypasses RpcClient; transport must be constructed before one-shot onApproved or ready() hangs forever; E_NO_HANDLER version skew degrades cleanly.
pwaAdoption: Copy the swap-the-API-object pattern: spread a local baseline, override core-bound members with bridge-built ones, document remote/local/refuse per member — wrong-machine silent no-ops are the worst outcome.

question: KQ1
summary: Envelope: t-discriminated req/cast/res/ev; incrementing nextId + pending Map correlates responses; strict parseRpcMessage validation; undef is an out-of-band index list so omitted args restore as undefined while meaningful null survives and no attacker-chosen value can forge the marker.
pwaAdoption: Adopt envelope verbatim for Pi Remote RPC; the undef index list fixes both the omitted-arg-becomes-null default-parameter bug and sentinel injection in one mechanism.

question: KQ1
summary: Events arriving before any subscriber are buffered (cap 4096, drop oldest) and flushed on first subscribe, closing the open-vs-subscribe race where the server pushes in the same macrotask as socket open.
pwaAdoption: SvelteKit store subscriptions mount after connect; a capped early-buffer flushed on first subscribe prevents permanently missed initial events without server replay support.

question: KQ1
summary: buildStubApi degrades by contract: on* return callable no-op unsubscribes (React cleanup), boot-awaited members resolve benign values (getPolicy {minSupported:null,mandatory:false}, cliCaps fail-open), rest reject coded E_UNSUPPORTED; satisfies Omit<NodeTerminalApi,...> makes the compiler the completeness gate.
pwaAdoption: Use the same three-tier degrade for desktop-only capabilities in Pi Remote and enforce stub coverage with an exhaustive satisfies type so new API members force a conscious decision.
